title: Simplify session state and attention tests

intentCoverage.report: Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-341#simplify-session-state-tests at 77f61a651ff8563aae7aaec884eebf0563608fd1 Verdict: Caught. This is limited to the observed path: an unreadable Claude listing, where a session entry shows "State unknown" with the host's note. Promise checked: the page renders the reading the rule computes (key examples 2 and 3; story goal: "every reading of a native session state is proven by a browser-free rule test; the end-to-end journeys keep one representative change per integrated behavior"). The integrated behavior checked: the entry shows the reading's note next to its label for every reading, not only for the readings that need attention. Why I changed the suggested target: the suggested UI faults are already asserted directly by the story's own journeys, so a probe would add little: - The "Needs input: " note: pace journey, expectSessionShown(entry, "Needs input: npm test", true). - The attention edge: expectSessionShown checks border-left-width 4px or 1px. It runs on "Ready for review" and, in card-states, on "Session stopped" (halted). - Open terminal on an unavailable session: pace journey, openTerminalControl(entry) toHaveCount(0). The story did remove a page-level check. Before the story, the pace journey asserted the unknown note "State unknown: Claude Code's session list could not be read" through attentionLaunches. Now its unknown step uses only toContainText("State unknown"), and card-states uses /State unknown/. So I probed the note on a reading that does not need attention. Fault: in dashboard/src/ShownSession.tsx, the note renders only for readings that need attention: - {note !== undefined && : {note}} + {needsAttention && note !== undefined && : {note}} This is a plausible mistake of treating the note as only "the attention reason". The rule module (nativeSessionShown/sessionShown) is unchanged, so the rule test cannot see this fault. No fixtures or assertions were changed. Maintained checks examined (one command from the scratch dashboard/ directory): env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts backend-tests/sessions/session-reading-rule.spec.ts tests/sessions/agent-launch-session-state-pace.spec.ts tests/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-session-states.spec.ts tests/sessions/agent-launch-ad-hoc-sessions.spec.ts [+ scratch witness] --workers=2 --reporter=list I added agent-launch-ad-hoc-sessions.spec.ts as the nearest maintained page check that still asserts the exact unknown note (line 184). Load average at the start was about 20. Run observations: 1. Baseline (unfaulted, no witness): 14/14 passed (50.9 s runner). This includes all 7 rule tests, both pace tests, the card-states test and the 4 ad-hoc tests. 2. Faulted, with an independent scratch witness. The witness, tests/sessions/zz-ic341-witness.spec.ts, is an untracked copy of the pace journey's first test. Its only change is that the unknown step asserts expectSessionShown(entry, "State unknown: Claude Code's session list could not be read", false). Result: 13 passed, 2 failed (41.1 s runner). - Wrong behavior confirmed on the story's own path: the witness failed at zz-ic341-witness.spec.ts:99 with Expected "State unknown: Claude Code's session list could not be read", Received "State unknown". This was on the story-card Execution entry after claudeListingFails(true) and one pace. - Caught by maintained proof: tests/sessions/agent-launch-ad-hoc-sessions.spec.ts:163, "with the listing unreadable, an ad hoc session's record can be deleted from Taken…". The failing assertion is line 185, expect(sessionStateOf(newer)).toHaveText(unknown), with the same Expected/Received. Path: a Taken ad hoc SessionEntry rendered through the same shownSession() after a reload with the listing unreadable. - Passed under the fault: all 7 rule tests, both pace journey tests, and the card-states journey. Their unknown steps did run the faulted reading, but they assert only the "State unknown" prefix. The story's own journeys have an assertion gap for this fault; the suite-level catch comes from the ad-hoc spec, which is outside this story's scope. 3. Restored: ShownSession.tsx restored by an EXIT trap and confirmed byte-identical to the saved original (cmp). git diff was empty, and the only untracked path was the witness. The same command, including the witness, passed 15/15 (34.5 s runner). That also shows the witness passes on correct code. I then deleted the witness. The scratch checkout was back to its pre-probe state (git status empty), and I removed it with git worktree remove. The execution checkout was not touched (git status empty). Next proof action: none is required for this fault, because maintained proof catches it. Recognition, not a new repair decision: after this story, agent-launch-ad-hoc-sessions.spec.ts:184-185 is the only page assertion among the checks I examined that proves a no-attention reading's note is rendered. The queued SEED-341#simplify-remaining-session-tests will simplify that spec's family. If that story shortens the assertion to a prefix, as this story did in the pace journey, the fault would go uncaught. The caller may want that story to keep one exact no-attention note assertion, or to tighten the pace journey's unknown step to expectSessionShown(entry, "State unknown: Claude Code's session list could not be read", false). I did not search for other owners across the whole suite. Costs: - Test runtime: 126.5 s measured, as the Playwright runner's totals (baseline 50.9 s + faulted 41.1 s + restored 34.5 s). Wall-clock for the three commands was 132.2 s measured (53.1 + 43.0 + 36.0 s). The setup-native npm/browser time was not separately measured. - Human effort: unavailable. There was no human interaction during the probe and no separate measure. - Agent effort: unavailable as a supported measure. About 14 tool calls is an estimate from this session, not a token or time measure. - **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 286756 ms (measured), from 1794556453204 to 1794556739960 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body. ## Wrap-up disposition Checked revision: 77f61a651ff8563aae7aaec884eebf0563608fd1. Decision: repaired within the story. The prefix-only unknown-state assertion was introduced by this story, so the pace journey's unknown step now asserts the whole reading, "State unknown: Claude Code's session list could not be read", without attention (416a3387bd60a5e5df7ebee184f45ac367c1d158). Evidence: with the report's ShownSession.tsx fault applied, agent-launch-session-state-pace.spec.ts:59 failed (Expected the full note, Received "State unknown"); restored, both pace cases passed. No follow-up queued for this finding.
